note: det_v0 with per-outcome intercepts re-set to logit(observed base rate). INSIDER_EXIT intercepts are from the M4 retrospective backfill (checkpoint 8.3, 2026-09-08). LIQ_IMPAIRED@24h, DRAWDOWN_80@24h and TRADING_ALIVE@24h intercepts are updated from the 2026-09-09 re-featured backfill (--refeature, all 1,250 retrospective launches rebuilt; this run also fixed the wrong-pool quote bug). SELL_IMPAIRED is deliberately withheld from biasOverride even though that same run made it newly measurable (~96% true, n~50): a rate that extreme, from a resolver whose only prior read on this cell was contaminated, needs an independent ground-truth cross-check (not just a bigger sample through the same resolver) before it goes into a public forecaster — see `notMeasured.SELL_IMPAIRED@1h` and DECISIONS.md. Only cells with a trustworthy observed rate get a `biasOverride`; every other cell keeps its det_v0 hand-set prior and is labelled 'not measured' in `provenance`. When feature coverage is poor (>70% of features null) the caller emits the base rate at confidence:low rather than this logistic. det_v0.2 (the full re-featured 14-day backfill, this refeature run's superset) will re-derive every cell.

LIQ_IMPAIRED@24h.note: refeatured; n 144 -> 194 (positives derived from the logged n×rate, not the raw count — exact log wasn't retained)

DRAWDOWN_80@24h.note: refeatured; n 102 -> 131, previous 'floor' caveat (dead tokens with no price series dropping out of the denominator) presumed improved by --refeature but not re-verified. positives derived from n×rate.

TRADING_ALIVE@24h.note: positive polarity: rate = P(still trading). refeatured, n 79 -> 204. positives derived from n×rate.

notMeasured.INSIDER_EXIT@72h: 0 resolved (few qualified launches >= 72h old in the 14d window)
notMeasured.SELL_IMPAIRED@1h: measured at 96.2% (n=53) by the 2026-09-09 refeature — the same run that fixed the wrong-pool quote bug this cell was previously contaminated by. Withheld anyway: n=53 (~2 negative cases) can't rule out a residual artifact in the same resolver, and there is no cross-check computed by independent logic yet. A companion effort (cohort-extraction, a ~3,500-token dataset built for a different purpose) could eventually supply that independent check once its own data-integrity pass is done — see DECISIONS.md.
notMeasured.SELL_IMPAIRED@24h: measured at 95.9% (n=49) by the same run; same reasoning as @1h.
